project_name: BPO RPI Calling Module — RevLoop Admin Engine
emotional_archetype: ARCHETYPE 2 & 4: Tactical Command Center & Swiss High Contrast (High-density telemetry, instant status recognition, zero visual clutter)

layout_strategy.grid_mode: MODE B: High Density Grid (Dashboards & Analytics)
layout_strategy.header_nav: RevLoop Admin Sticky Top Bar with brand logo, campaign selector dropdown, system health status indicator (Vapi API connected, ElevenLabs active), theme toggle, and supervisor profile avatar.
layout_strategy.sidebar_navigation: Collapsible left sidebar with direct navigation items: Campaigns, Live Calls, Contact Records, Audio Transcripts, Provider Settings, Audit Logs.

key_modules_and_components.name: Telemetry KPI Header Grid
key_modules_and_components.description: 4-column high density stat cards displaying Total Uploaded Contacts, RPI Confirmation Rate (%), Wrong Party Deflection %, No-Answer/Voicemail %, Active Concurrent Calls, and Avg Call Duration (sec).

key_modules_and_components.name: Campaign Control & Operational Bar
key_modules_and_components.description: Primary actionable bar with Launch Campaign (Batch Start), Pause Outbound Queue, Retry Failed Numbers, Export CSV Report, and Upload CSV Contacts trigger.

key_modules_and_components.name: CSV Upload & Validation Report Modal
key_modules_and_components.description: Drag-and-drop CSV handler with instant pre-flight validation listing duplicate phone numbers, invalid formatting, missing customer IDs, and language breakdown with confirmation step before launching.

key_modules_and_components.name: Data-Dense Contact & Call Results Table
key_modules_and_components.description: Table-first design with columns: Customer ID, Name, Phone Number, Language, Voice ID, Call Status, Disposition Badge, Retries Count, Last Duration, Timestamps, and Call Details Action.

key_modules_and_components.name: Call Detail Drawer (Control Room View)
key_modules_and_components.description: Multi-section side drawer triggered per call row. Includes Vapi Provider Status, Call ID copy button, Interactive Audio Recording Player with waveform simulation, Full Turn-by-Turn AI vs Customer Transcript, Timestamped STT latency, and Verification outcome logs.

key_modules_and_components.name: Admin / Supervisor Settings Panel
key_modules_and_components.description: Explicit form settings for Vapi API Key, Phone Number ID, Webhook Callback URL, Voice Profile Mapping (Male/Female voice IDs per language: EN-US, ES-US, FR-CA), Free-text AI Verification Prompt Editor, and Retry Rules (max retries, delay interval).

key_modules_and_components.name: Audit Log View
key_modules_and_components.description: Real-time timeline of administrative actions, API call triggers, campaign state changes, credential updates, and batch retries.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a production-grade React application with Tailwind CSS and Shadcn UI primitives for the BPO RPI Outbound Calling Module.
Follow the RevLoop admin style with dense, high-clarity data displays and dark slate/obsidian palette.
Do NOT use teal blue/green (#1B93A4) or Space Grotesk font.
Use data-testid attributes on ALL interactive buttons, table rows, filter tabs, modal controls, and settings inputs.
Provide realistic mock data generation for BPO contacts, Vapi calls, transcripts, and disposition stats so the dashboard feels active out of the box.
Ensure CSV upload validation checks phone numbers (+1 E.164 format check), duplicate detection, and missing fields, showing a clear pre-import error breakdown.
Ensure the call detail drawer contains a working simulated audio player with waveform visualization and readable speaker-labeled transcript items.
Keep settings form editable and store configuration state cleanly so supervisors can modify Vapi credentials, prompt scripts, and voice mappings.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic centered layouts or unstyled templates. Use RevLoop structured admin navigation and high-density panels.
Every state change (launching campaign, pausing queue, filtering table, saving settings) must have explicit feedback toasts via Sonner.
Use 1px crisp borders (`border-slate-800`) with high contrast text for APCA accessibility.
No universal transition classes (`transition-all`). Target specific CSS properties like `transition-colors` or `transition-opacity`.
